channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: State allowed to appeal interim release order in asylum seeker detention case
item.description: Court allows State Advocate, IPA to appeal a decree ordering the interim release of asylum seeker Ajil Al Muhsen, despite a judge’s sharp criticism of the government’s evidence and his expressed doubts over the merits of continued detention

item.title: US strikes Venezuela, captures Maduro
item.description: Trump says Venezuelan president and wife have been seized and flown out of country following large-scale military operation

item.title: MEP Thomas Bajada calls for urgent action against AI-generated sexual abuse
item.description: Thomas Bajada urges EU colleagues to regulate non-consensual AI content, warning technology is being weaponised to harm individuals and minors

item.title: Looking back 2025 | They said it on MaltaToday
item.description: Part 2 of 2 | A look back at the best quotes from the weekly interviews with various protagonists from the political, social and cultural spheres

item.title: PN blames minister over Gozo Channel chaos, claims vessels operated at half their capacity
item.description: Opposition says Gozo Minister Clint Camilleri’s mismanagement led to vessels operating at half their capacity on Friday, causing long delays for passengers wanting to cross to Malta

item.title: World reacts to US military strikes on Venezuela
item.description: Global reaction to US strikes and capture of Venezuela President Nicolas Maduro includes calls for de-escalation and an urgent UN Security Council meeting • EU expresses concern for citizens says ‘principles of international law must be respected’

item.title: Government denies negligence over Birgu house collapse
item.description: Ministry insists preventive measures were in place despite Opposition claims that warnings were ignored for years

item.title: Gozo Ministry dismisses PN claims over ferry delays, cites record tourism success
item.description: Government says strong demand and weather caused Friday's disruption, while the Opposition blames staff shortages for vessels operating at half capacity

item.title: Trump says US will run Venezuela until safe transition can take place
item.description: US President Donald Trump says Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, are being taken to New York following overnight US military strikes on Venezuela

item.title: Man dies after garage wall collapses in Qormi
item.description: Building and Construction Authority and Occupational Health and Safety Authority say no works had been approved for the site
